name: side-lying-rear-delt-fly
instructions:
1. Secure a flat bench and select the desired weight from the rack.
2. Hold one dumbbell directly in front of you while side lying against the bench. Use your free hand to support your head and bend your knees slightly to allow the bench to support your weight.
3. Take a deep breath and pull the dumbbell towards the ceiling using the rear deltoid.
4. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
